name: LadyDevimon
main_effect: [When Digivolving] You may trash 1 card in your hand to reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 yellow and 1 purple Digimon with the [Angel], [Archangel] or [Fallen Angel] trait among them to your hand. Place the remaining cards at the bottom of your deck in any order.
source_effect: [Your Turn] All of your yellow Digimon gain ＜Retaliation＞ (When this Digimon is deleted after losing a battle, delete the Digimon it was battling.).
set_name: ST-10: Starter Deck Parallel World Tactician
